template_policy.values: typed Rust structs serialized as versioned data
template_policy.commit: values, Markdown, AST digest, index, and audit event atomically

sip.pre_phase: not_allowed; SIP is populated at init
sip.ready_guard: issue-specific goal, outcome, scope, and authority are nonempty and non-generic

stp.pre_phase: constructed at init from issue contract
stp.ready_guard: acceptance is observable, dependencies explicit, and scope does not exceed SIP

spp.pre_phase: constructed at init with pending typed steps
spp.ready_guard: all steps issue-specific; estimates explicit; statuses are pending/in_progress/completed; no unsupported completion

vpp.pre_phase: constructed at init from declared outcome and paths; remains pre_phase until SPP ready
vpp.ready_guard: all required lanes classified, argv arrays bounded, budgets explicit, and deferred work is not passed proof

srp.pre_phase: constructed at init as pre_review with prompts and no result
srp.ready_guard: pre-publication review records exact revision and every actionable finding is fixed; post-publication findings remain distinct

sor.pre_phase: constructed at init as explicit pre_execution scaffold; empty outcome is valid but never complete
sor.ready_guard: actual-only facts; terminal completeness requires remote and local closeout truth

field_ownership_rules: one owning card per mutable fact
later cards reference earlier facts by stable identifier and digest
later cards record disposition without silently rewriting earlier truth
scope changes return to SIP/STP and invalidate downstream readiness
plan changes increment SPP revision and invalidate review
validation-plan changes increment VPP revision and invalidate affected proof
implementation revision changes invalidate pre-publication SRP result
SOR records actual facts and never backfills planned proof as passed

cross_card_invariants.rule: issue, repository, slug, and version agree across all cards and index
STP task and deliverables are within SIP declared scope
every STP acceptance criterion maps to at least one SPP step and VPP proof role
SPP and VPP reference the current issue design and Mermaid diagram digests
VPP lanes cover touched surfaces and do not hide blocked/deferred proof
SRP reviewed revision equals the publication revision
SOR validation and integration claims cite retained evidence and observed remote state
phase and card generations never move backward except an explicit supersede/replan transition

compatibility.migration: pure typed values migration before rendering
compatibility.legacy_markdown: one-way mdast import with unknown-node report
compatibility.rollback: retain prior values/render/index generation until atomic commit succeeds

expected_pipeline: validate VPP anchors and SPP/VPP budget invariants
